instruction: How much money have I sent to or received from others on venmo this month so far?
notes: Read-only information task: no database changes are allowed, so the only state changes are knowledge predicates. The month window is fixed by static facts (month-start, now) derived from the given current datetime, so no phone date lookup is needed. venmo.show_transactions is called once per direction (sent, received) with min/max created_at filters; `sent` and `received` are domain constants of type direction so complete-task can require both retrievals structurally. The answer object total-amount-this-month is a runtime value (sum of amounts across both retrievals, including all pages); (answer-amount ...) in :init merely designates which object carries the computed answer. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every action and the goal conjunction in its precondition.
